style: Realistic documentary footage at real-time speed, not slow motion. Handheld energy, fast camera movement, natural true-to-life colors with no color grading and no film look. Sharp, busy, intense. Full-frame image edge to edge with no vignette, no black borders, no letterbox. No readable text, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.prompt: A chef tossing food in a flaming wok in a crowded restaurant kitchen, fire flaring up, cooks rushing past in the background.
Close-up of order tickets printing rapidly in a busy restaurant kitchen while a cook tears them off and slaps them onto the rail.
A barista knocking out a portafilter, locking it into the espresso machine and blasting the steam wand, quick confident moves, busy cafe behind.
High overhead shot of a packed city crosswalk as the light changes and hundreds of people rush across in every direction.
Tracking shot alongside a delivery cyclist weaving fast through downtown traffic, cars and buses passing close.
Extreme close-up of a thumb rapidly tapping and swiping on a smartphone screen, quick cuts of light on the glass.
A smartphone on a cafe table buzzing and lighting up again and again with incoming notifications, a hand snatches it up.
An athlete slamming heavy battle ropes in a crowded gym, sweat flying, fast handheld camera circling.
Close-up of a boxer hitting a heavy bag in a gritty boxing gym, fast combinations, the bag jolting with each punch.
Close-up of a barber's clippers buzzing up the side of a client's head, hair flying, quick precise strokes.
A florist's hands quickly gathering stems, wrapping a bouquet in paper and tying it off in a busy flower shop.
Thick foam and high-pressure water blasting across a car in a car wash bay, spray hitting the camera side.
A mechanic zipping lug nuts off a wheel with an impact wrench in a busy auto shop, the car up on a lift.
A wet dog shaking off water at a grooming salon, droplets spraying everywhere, groomer laughing.
Fast whip pan across a wall of sneakers in a busy shoe store as a clerk pulls a shoebox from the stack.
Close-up of a customer tapping a phone on a card reader at a busy store counter, approval light, receipt printing.
A clerk handing filled shopping bags across a counter to a customer in a crowded boutique, quick handoff, people moving behind.
A pizza maker pulling a blistered pizza out of a roaring wood-fired oven with a long peel, flames inside.
A bartender shaking a cocktail hard and pouring it into a glass at a packed bar, crowd behind.
Fast whip pan down a busy downtown street at night, shop lights and car headlights streaking with motion blur.
Fast drone flight low along a busy downtown main street at dusk, past storefronts, people and traffic.
Fast aerial shot over a freeway interchange at night, streams of headlights and taillights rushing in every direction.
Packages racing along conveyor belts and sorting chutes in a busy shipping warehouse.
Hands quickly packing an order into a cardboard box and sealing it with a tape gun in a small business stockroom.
Camera following a server from behind as they carry plates through a crowded, noisy restaurant dining room.
Fast push through the front door of a bright modern house as a real estate agent swings it open for a couple.
A packed concert crowd with dozens of phones held up and glowing, lights sweeping over the crowd.
A subway train roaring into a busy station platform as commuters surge toward the doors.
Sparks spraying from an angle grinder cutting metal in a small fabrication workshop.
Close-up of a phone screen being tapped by a customer in a busy store, shoppers and shelves moving past behind them.
Friends at a crowded restaurant table laughing and clinking glasses together, fast handheld camera.
View from behind a coffee shop counter of a long morning line moving fast, baristas calling orders and handing cups over.
